(2) The scene cuts to a man with glasses and a black headset sitting on a blue couch, leaning against a white pillow. He is wearing a dark navy T-shirt and speaking into a microphone. (3) A third person, a man with long hair pulled back in a ponytail wearing a black-and-white striped T-shirt and black headphones, is shown in profile speaking into a microphone. (4) The visuals alternate rapidly between the three individuals as they react with vibrant facial expressions, broad smiles, and open-mouthed laughter. The woman leans back significantly while laughing, and the man on the couch smiles broadly while looking towards the woman's direction.
